description: The signed-in person's move events after an epoch-millisecond timestamp, oldest first — drafted, sent, called, answered, done, skipped. Use it to answer "what changed since we last spoke" without re-reading the whole plan. Capped; more says how many were left out.

limit.description: Most recent N of the matches (default 100, max 500).
